name: Friend Ahead Attacks

name: Friend Ahead Faints

name: Friend Bought

name: Friend Eats Food

name: Friend Faints
description: Trigger. Activates when any allied pet faints during battle.

name: Friend Hurt
description: Trigger. Activates when another friendly pet takes damage but survives.

name: Friend Levels Up
description: Trigger. Activates when another friendly pet levels up.

name: Friend Sold
description: Trigger. Activates when another friendly pet is sold.

name: Friend Summoned
description: Trigger. Activates when a new friend is summoned to the team.

name: Hurt
description: Trigger. Activates when the pet takes damage but survives.

name: Knock Out
description: Trigger. Activates when the pet defeats an enemy with its attack.

name: Level-up
description: Trigger. Activates when the pet levels up to level 2 or level 3.

name: Roll
description: Trigger. Activates when the shop is rolled for new pets and food.

name: Sell
description: Trigger. Activates when the pet is sold from the team.

name: Start of Battle
description: Trigger. Activates once at the start of battle before any attacks.

name: Start of Turn
description: Trigger. Activates when a new shop turn begins.

name: Attack
description: Mechanic. The damage a pet deals in battle. Pets in front attack simultaneously each round of battle.

name: Battle
description: Mechanic. The combat phase against another player. Pets in front fight first until one team has no pets left.

name: Combine
description: Mechanic. Merge two of the same pet into one. The combined pet keeps the best stats plus a small bonus and gains experience.

name: Experience
description: Mechanic. Pets earn experience by combining duplicates. Two points reach level 2 and a total of five reaches level 3.

name: Food
description: Mechanic. Consumables purchased in the shop that grant stats or perks to your pets.

name: Freeze
description: Mechanic. Lock a pet or food in the shop so it stays available next turn.

name: Gold
description: Mechanic. The currency used to buy pets, roll the shop, and feed pets food. You start each turn with ten gold.

name: Health
description: Mechanic. A pet's hit points. When health reaches zero, the pet faints and is removed from battle.

name: Hearts
description: Mechanic. Your life total. You lose hearts when you lose a battle. When hearts reach zero you are eliminated.

name: Level
description: Mechanic. Combine three of the same pet to reach level 2, then 3. Higher level strengthens the pet's ability and grants a shop reward.

name: Mana
description: Mechanic. A pet-specific resource. Pets gain mana from abilities and spend it on effects like healing, summoning, or buffing. Mana halves at the end of each turn.

name: Pack
description: Mechanic. A collection of pets that share a theme. Packs include Standard, Expansion, Golden, Star, Puppy, Unicorn, Danger, Weekly, and custom mini packs.

name: Perk
description: Mechanic. A persistent effect granted by certain foods such as Honey, Garlic, Melon, Steak, Coconut, or Peanut. A pet can only hold one perk at a time.

name: Pet
description: Mechanic. The units you collect and battle with. Each has attack, health, a tier, and an ability.

name: Roll
description: Mechanic. Spend one gold to refresh the shop with new pets and food choices.

name: Shop
description: Mechanic. The buying phase between battles where you purchase pets, food, and toys.

name: Tier
description: Mechanic. Pets and food are grouped into tiers 1 through 6. Higher tiers unlock as you reach higher turn levels in the shop.

name: Toy
description: Mechanic. Items that appear at higher turns. Each toy has a timer that counts down, then breaks to trigger an effect.

name: Trumpet
description: Mechanic. A team resource gained from certain abilities. When one or zero friends remain, trumpets are spent to summon a Golden Retriever with attack and health equal to the trumpet count.
